scenes.vo: What is pre execution protection? It means deciding whether new code may run, before it runs.
scenes.caption: What is pre-execution protection? It means deciding whether new code may run, before it runs.

scenes.vo: Antivirus usually acts once code is already in memory. Pre execution protection holds every new program, script and injected payload at a checkpoint, the moment it arrives.
scenes.caption: Antivirus usually acts once code is already in memory. Pre-execution protection holds every new program, script and injected payload at a checkpoint, the moment it arrives.

scenes.vo: Then it reads intent. A file no one has seen before is judged on what it would do, so it does not need a signature to be stopped.

scenes.vo: So the whole idea fits in three steps. Hold the code. Read its intent. Decide, before it runs. Nothing runs without a verdict.
